dataList.content:
In every world of possibilities that may or may not have been.
在可能或不可能存在的所有世界中……

Every Catherine and Heathcliff of all worlds call out to each other, feeling the echoes of their partners.
所有世界中的凯瑟琳和希斯克利夫在互相呼唤着能些微感知到的对方。

They struggle for the one last unseen embrace.
他们挣扎着想要拥抱不可见的彼此。

dataList.content:
Where are you, Cathy?! I wish to have you in my embrace again.
凯茜！你在哪里？我想再一次拥你入怀。

I have felt your presence all along. I knew for certain that you have been haunting me.
我一直都能感受到你。我知道你一直在我的身边徘徊不去。

dataList.content:
You lie not beneath the cold earth; you are beside me, are you not?
你不在地下，你就在此地，就在我身边的某处。对吗？

dataList.content:
Heathcliff! Why do you refuse to embrace me?
希斯克利夫！你为什么不来到我的身边？

I have not broken your heart—you have broken it; and in breaking it, you have broken mine...!
我没有撕碎你的心。是你撕碎了它。你撕碎了你自己的心，然后连我的也一并撕碎了！

dataList.content:
Do come to me, Heathcliff! Whisk me away and embrace me in your heart—the gust here is too cold; my body is turning into ice. Only by your warmth shall the frost thaw!
来我这里，希斯克利夫！拥我入怀！这里的风太冷了，我的身体也和它一起变得寒冷如冰！能将它融化的，只有你！

Millions of worlds made real by Catherine and Heathcliff begin speeding by before us.
因凯瑟琳和希斯克利夫而诞生的无数个世界，开始在我们眼前划过。

Every possibility of Heathcliff and Catherine.
这是属于凯瑟琳和希斯克利夫的，全部的可能性。

Most end in a tragedy, full of suffering and lamentation...
其中的大多数都被绝望与悲痛所充斥，

But among the infinity, I catch a glimpse of tranquility.
但在无数的可能性中，我注意到一幅寂静无比的景象。
dataList.place:
Wuthering Heights of a Certain Future
某个未来中的呼啸山庄

dataList.content:
Outside the manor, there are two gravestones marking Heathcliff and Catherine's final resting places.
建筑外面有不知何时立起来的，希斯克利夫和凯瑟琳的墓碑……

And in the desolate, forlorn moorlands of Wuthering Heights...
在呼啸山庄，在那片一无所有的荒凉土地上，

... are two youths who each resemble Heathcliff and Catherine. They gaze deeply into each other's eyes; their mouths drawn into the sweetest, happiest smiles.
长得像希斯克利夫和凯瑟琳的两个孩子在呼啸山庄的庭院里，正面带笑意地幸福相望。

Their hearts connected. Despite everything.
无论发生了什么样的事情，二人始终心意相通。

dataList.content:
They were...
……那些孩子们……

I see... I let my conviction... blind myself to the other possibilities...
从一开始，这一切就都已经注定……你看到了吗……
dataList.title:
A Distant World
另一个世界

dataList.content:
Erlking Heathcliff's last words are hollow and bittersweet. Its echoes scatter into nothingness.
随着魔王希斯克利夫的消失，他苦涩地说出的最后一句话也消散了。

Catherine begins to disappear from every world.
所有世界中的凯瑟琳都开始消失。

As though she was never there.
如同她从未存在过一般。

And when Every Catherine eventually disappeared...
所有凯瑟琳都消失之后……

Millions of changing possibilities appeared before us.
无尽变化的可能性，再次于我们面前显形。

Mr. Earnshaw brings Heathcliff from the Backstreets.
恩肖先生把希斯克利夫从后巷里带了回来。

Hindley's scorn and hatred for Heathcliff remained the same...
亨德利一如既往地对希斯克利夫充满轻蔑。

... but without Catherine, Heathcliff had no reason to endure the suffering in Wuthering Heights.
但在没有凯瑟琳的呼啸山庄，希斯克利夫没有理由再忍受下去了。

So he quickly moves on from Wuthering Heights. Each Heathcliff...
早早地从呼啸山庄离开了的希斯克利夫……

... lives a different life, meets all kinds of different people...
过着不同的生活，与不同的人相遇……

... and lives on without Catherine.
过着没有凯瑟琳的人生。

Our Heathcliff watched as the worlds transformed.
我们的希斯克利夫注视着那所有世界的景象。

Each Heathcliff living a life of his own, and Catherine's existence slowly fading away from him.
各自度过不同人生的希斯克利夫，和抛下他逐渐消失的凯瑟琳。

I would have understood if Heathcliff were to curse me with weeping, cruel words. I would have understood if he were to grab and shake me by the collar.
就算希斯克利夫用混着呜咽的声音诅咒我，或是揪住我的衣领问我为什么要那么做，我也能理解。

To erase someone's entire existence... is an unimaginably terrible thing.
永远抹去某人的存在……是一件无法想象的恐怖之事。

But Heathcliff was watching all of it in silence. As if he wished to carve each and every single one of them into his memory.
但是希斯克利夫平静地注视着这一切的发生，像是要把一切都刻在眼中一般。

And...
然后……

Finally, there isn't anything left.
最后，一切都消失殆尽。

Nelly... are you taking the Golden Bough?
你要……带走金枝吗，耐莉？

Nelly stood atop the railings of the rooftop and gazed down at us.
耐莉站在屋顶的栏杆上，凝视着我们。

Most Sinners had fallen or were unconscious.
大多数的罪人都已经倒下或处于失去意识的状态。

In her hands she held the Golden Bough that appeared to have been pried from the rooftop.
……耐莉手握着那似乎从屋顶上抽出来的金枝。

But Heathcliff...
但是希斯克利夫啊……

You are a good, kindhearted boy, aren't you? I'm certain you understand.
你是一个心地善良的孩子，所以能理解的吧？

I suppose I will bring this to the one who first showed me the mirror shard.
我想把这个送给最开始让我见到镜子碎片的那个人。

You know it's futile.
你知道那是没有意义的吧。

You and your friends... have fought battle after battle, pushed yourselves past the brink of exhaustion. How will you stop a Chief Butler who has waited for this precise moment?
你和你的朋友们……已经在战斗中拼尽全力，力竭倒下。你们要怎样阻止……一位一直在等待此刻的首席管家？

They can turn the clock, but I will no longer be here once the hands turn once.
在那个钟表转动一圈的时间内，足够让我隐去身姿了。

Sure. I can't stop you now. But...
是啊，我们现在没法阻止你了。但……

But I'll get it all back.
但我会取回来。

The Golden Bough. My Catherine.
无论是金枝，还是我的凯瑟琳……

Catherine? Who are you talking about?
凯瑟琳？你在说谁？

I can't say I understand what you are talking about, Heathcliff.
你说了些莫名其妙的话，希斯克利夫。

... I know.
……我知道。

That name no longer means anything to you or anyone else. Nothing but an ink stain remains where she once stood.
对于你和其他人而言，这个名字已经成为记忆中的一片墨渍。

But she's never been clearer to me. So, so clear that it can never be erased.
但她的存在对我而言是如此鲜明，永远无法从我的记忆中被抹去。

Well, if you are that desperate... then I hope your wish shall come true one day.
如果你真有那么急切的话，希望你有朝一日真能把她找回来。

It is said that the Golden Bough can make any wish... any heart... come true.
据说只要有金枝，无论是怎样的愿望……怎样的心情……都能实现。
